popup.title: Helm and Cloak
popup.description: A high-end inn, rooming house, and [[festhall]], popular both with travelers and with local residents, who enjoyed its resplendent dining room. It was also home to the majority of the [[Knights of the Unicorn]], who rented most of the upper floor.

popup.title: Three Old Kegs
popup.description: A well-known inn widely regarded as one of the best establishments in all of [[Faerûn]], and was known for its comfortable furnishings and generally somnific atmosphere.

popup.title: Blade and Stars
popup.description: A quiet inn known for its high-quality foodstuffs, and a legend of a [[yuan-ti]] being trapped within the inn's walls, imprisoned while fighting a [[wizard]].

popup.title: Splurging Sturgeon
popup.description: Once a threadbare inn and tavern, turned into a fanciful eatery specializing in seafood, both exotic and local in [[1482 DR]].

popup.title: Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern
popup.description: A very famous inn and tavern frequented by merchants, business owners, and adventurers.

popup.title: Ascloakan's Fine Inn
popup.description: An inn of note at the meeting of [[Hammaskarl's Ride]] and [[Talankar's Lane]].

popup.title: Drakon Tavern
popup.description: A relatively small inn and tavern located next door to the [[Gist]] family estate with a small park plaza at the building's back.{{approx}}

popup.title: Keexie Tavern
popup.description: A simple tavern and inn that served as a front for [[Baldur's Gate]]'s thieves guild in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]], located across the plaza from [[Sorcerous Sundries]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Nortale's Hostel
popup.description: Cheap temporary lodgings, used to house refugees during the [[Absolute crisis]] of [[1492 DR]].{{approx}}
